GalleryConfig.title: GalleryConfig
GalleryConfig.description: Main configuration document holding the construction services gallery structure and photo metadata.

servicesJson.description: JSON serialized array of ServiceItem objects where base64 photo URLs are stored in gallery_photos collection.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp in milliseconds when the gallery was last updated.

updatedBy.description: Identifier of the client/session that updated the gallery.

GalleryPhoto.title: GalleryPhoto
GalleryPhoto.description: Individual optimized real construction photo document stored separately to stay well within Firestore 1MB limit.

serviceId.description: ID of the construction service category.

dataUrl.description: Optimized JPEG base64 Data URL (1200x900, quality 0.78).

updatedAt.description: Timestamp in milliseconds when the photo was uploaded or updated.

/gallery_config/{configId}.description: Stores the global gallery configuration shared across all visitors in real time.

/gallery_photos/{photoId}.description: Stores individual base64 construction photos referenced by gallery_config/main.
